sections.bio:
At S&P Global, our team excels in dissecting complex financial data to extract pivotal insights. With an MBA in Finance, my expertise lies in translating intricate data points into actionable strategies for our clients. My toolkit, enriched by Tally ERP and Microsoft Office, enables the creation of precise and accessible reports.

Transitioning from Data Researcher to Data Analyst, I've contributed to enhancing customer service by applying data-centric solutions. My discipline is shaped by Six Sigma principles, fostering a culture of accuracy and thoroughness. Our collective objective is to pioneer innovative approaches and lead with dedication, steering our team towards triumphs in the data realm.

Most people think Claude limits are the problem.

They’re not.

The real problem is using Claude inefficiently.

Most users waste tokens on unnecessary uploads, fragmented prompts, endless follow-ups, and poor workflow design.

The result?

⚠️ Higher usage
⚠️ Slower outputs
⚠️ Lower-quality results

The best Claude users don't necessarily write better prompts.
They build better systems.

Here are 14 practical ways to get more from Claude while using fewer tokens:

✅ Convert files before uploading
✅ Plan before executing
✅ Ask Claude to ask questions first
✅ Edit sections instead of regenerating everything
✅ Batch multiple tasks into one prompt
✅ Reuse proven prompt frameworks
✅ Choose the right model for the job
✅ Keep files and folders clean
✅ Start a new chat for a new task
✅ Summarize long conversations regularly
✅ Disable features you don't need
✅ Use Projects for recurring work
✅ Set preferences once and save time forever
✅ Think in workflows, not prompts

The biggest AI shift happening right now:

People who win with AI aren't the ones who know the most prompts.

They're the ones who know how to design efficient workflows.

Prompting gets you answers.

Systems get you results.
